entry.title: 9X9 1.0.1
entry.summary: Circuit-solved TR-909 (Lemus) with 9W9's panel, drive, distortion and effects, for MPC Gen2. ## Requirements - A Gen2 MPC OS standalone device (64-bit ARM, aarch64: MPC Live III and the other 64-bit models) on MPC OS 3.x. The installer refuses anything else (the 32-bit Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61 need the `-mpc-armv7.zip` build). - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Gen2 devices keep plugins in the internal drive
